scope: Read-only preflight of the default Claude user configuration after the user reported installation. No real Claude model session or hook invocation has been tested.

issue.cause: Existing STYLE hooks reference a temporary go run executable that no longer exists. They also lack the current installation-bound STYLE home argument.
issue.impact: The inspected configuration cannot launch STYLE. This is an installation precondition failure, not a failed model-delivery test.
issue.next_step: User rebuilds the fixed binary and reruns section 4 of docs/STYLE-M1B-MANUAL.md with STYLE_HOME=$HOME/.style-m1b and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$HOME/.claude. Then start a fresh Claude session and inspect loaded hooks and session context. Do not overwrite the original pre-install backups.

reproduction: Run claude --version; read only STYLE hook command/args from $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/settings.json (default $HOME/.claude); check each command with test -f and test -x. Compare the installation-bound home against the harness entries in $STYLE_HOME/style.lock.yaml. Avoid printing unrelated settings or credentials.
